headline: Borac's four wins in five meet a KuPS side with four days' rest
summary: Borac Banja Luka's last five matches brought four wins, and the one defeat came in Europe: 1-2 at Panathinaikos, where they made just 0.23 expected goals. On Thursday they host KuPS, who lost their opener 4-2 at home to Trabzonspor and gave up 3.61 expected goals that night. Borac have had seven days to prepare, according to Press.rs; KuPS played on Sunday, four days before kick-off. Across 10 bookmakers, margin removed, Borac are 52.6% favourites, more than twice KuPS's chance. The market expects 2.42 goals.
read: Borac Banja Luka are clear home favourites at 52.6%, more than double KuPS's 20.7%, on the back of four wins in five and a full week's rest, while KuPS have lost three of five and played on Sunday. The market expects a controlled, low-scoring game, with the fair goal total at 2.42 and under 2.5 a slight favourite.

facts.fact: Borac Banja Luka are clear favourites at 52.6% to win, more than twice KuPS's 20.7%.
facts.meaning: The market makes this a home win or nothing: the draw sits at 26.7% and KuPS are rated the clear outsiders.

facts.fact: Borac's last five read LWWWW — four straight wins before the 1-2 defeat at Panathinaikos, nine goals scored and five conceded.
facts.meaning: They come into this on the best run of the two teams, and all four of those wins came without conceding more than two.

facts.fact: In their 1-2 defeat at Panathinaikos, Borac managed 0.23 xG against 3.8 for the hosts.
facts.meaning: The one time they stepped up in class this month they created almost nothing and were cut open repeatedly.

facts.fact: Borac's win chance across the books has risen from 49.4% to 52.8% since prices opened on Tuesday night.
facts.meaning: Money has come for the home side in the last 34 hours, and KuPS have drifted from 23.9% to 20.7% over the same period.

facts.fact: Borac have had seven days since their last match, while KuPS played on Sunday, four days before kick-off.
facts.meaning: The fresher legs are the home side's, against a KuPS team that has played Thursday and Sunday in each of the last two weeks.

facts.fact: KuPS have lost three of their last five (WLLLW) and conceded 1.91 xG per game across them.
facts.meaning: They arrive as underdogs with a defence that gives up good chances, even if they beat VPS 2-0 on Sunday.

facts.fact: The market's 50/50 goal total sits at 2.42, just under the 2.5 line.
facts.meaning: A tight game is expected: Under 2.5 is the slight favourite, and both teams to score is only just above a coin flip at 51.2%.

facts.fact: Both teams are on zero points after round one — Borac sit 26th and KuPS 31st of the 36 league-phase teams.
facts.meaning: Neither has banked anything yet, so the home side's need for a result is immediate and the table already separates them only on goal difference.

sources.fact: Borac Banja Luka are seeking their first points of the Conference League league phase in front of their home fans, according to Bosnian media.
Borac Banja Luka lost their opening Conference League match 2-1 away to Panathinaikos.
Borac coach Savić said his team will reach a result through quality play, according to Bosnian media.
Borac had no Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina obligations last weekend, giving them extra preparation time for this match, according to Serbian media.
KuPS lost their opening Conference League match 4-2 at home to Trabzonspor.
Finnish media describe Borac as the favourites and KuPS's opponent as considerably weaker than their first-round opposition.
Both teams lost their first-round matches, with Borac falling to Panathinaikos and KuPS to Trabzonspor.
